questions.question: According to the speaker, what matters most to communicate well?
options: Knowledge and practice, more than talent.

questions.question: Why does he ask for no laptops or phones?
options: We only have one language processor, so we get distracted.
Phones are not allowed at MIT.

questions.question: How should you start a talk?
Why should you repeat your main idea ("cycle")?
options: At any moment, about 20% of people aren't paying attention.

questions.question: How long can you wait for an answer after asking the audience a question?
What is the speaker's main goal for the audience?
options: That they build their own repertoire of speaking techniques.
That they copy his style exactly.

questions.question: Why is 11 a.m. a good time for a lecture?
options: People are awake and it isn't right after a meal.
